verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents dynamic crawling that executes JS and waits for async or sync dynamic content (gh-21). It also offers hooks for fine-grained browser control (docs-6), so waiting before returning rendered content is supported in general. Nothing in the pack shows a parameter that waits specifically for a CSS/XPath selector to appear. Missing for 10: an explicit wait-for-selector option, documentation of its syntax and timeout behavior, its availability through the Docker/FastAPI API, and independent hands-on confirmation.
